s01: ʔanˈi hajˈiti ʔosˈe ʔˈet zˈe ʃˈuv.
s02: zˈe lˈo kaʃˈe ʔˈim ʔatˈa lomˈed.
s05: baʁˈeɡa ʃetihjˈe lˈi hizdamnˈut, ʔavˈo levakˈeʁ.
s06: kibˈalnu hoʁaʔˈot ʔˈejχ lehaχˈin sˈal mibambuk.
s07: ʔolamˈenu hˈu ʁˈak χˈelek katˈan mehajekˈum.
s08: hˈaʁ pˈoɡi hˈu hahˈaʁ haɡavˈoa bejotˈeʁ bejapˈan.
s09: ɡˈuɡel siχakˈa tafkˈid χaʃˈuv behanɡaʃˈat hamejdˈa baʔˈinteʁnet.
s10: kaʃˈe lehitnaʔˈeʁ mehaʁˈeɡel leʔaχˈaʁ ʃehˈu mitkabˈea.
s11: ʔanˈi koʁˈe sˈefeʁ baʔˈeʁev lejˈad haχalˈon.
s12: hasˈefeʁ mehaʃχunˈa safˈaʁ ʔˈet hakˈesef vemijˈad sipˈeʁ lˈi ʔˈet kˈol hasipˈuʁ.
s13: hajˈeled halˈaχ laɡˈan babˈokeʁ ʔˈim hakˈelev.
s14: ʔanˈi ʁotsˈe leʔeχˈol lˈeχem ʔˈim χemʔˈa veʃˈemen zˈajit.
s15: hapɡiʃˈa nikbeʔˈa lejˈom ʃliʃˈi beʃaʔˈa ʃtˈajim vaχˈetsi.
s16: ʃemˈi daniʔˈel ʁozhˈil veʔanˈi ɡˈaʁ bjeʁuʃalˈajim.
s17: ʔanˈi meʔamˈen modˈel zihˈuj dibˈuʁ ʔˈal haklatˈot ʃˈel ʔatsmˈi.
s18: tasˈim ʔˈet haʔaʁɡˈaz ʔˈal hamiʃtˈaχ vetaʔavˈiʁ ʔotˈo ʔˈim hamalɡazˈe lamaχsˈan.
s19: ʃalˈaχti leχˈa mˈejl ʔˈim halˈink lekˈovets bedʁˈajev.
s20: ʔˈim lˈo jiʁˈed ɡˈeʃem maχˈaʁ, nisˈa lajˈam, noχˈal ʔaʁuχˈat tsohoʁˈajim venaχzˈoʁ lifnˈej haʃkiʔˈa.
